Enjoying this sweet soup with another person will bring you closer together.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Creamy Heart Soups are made by [[Cooking]] a [[Hydromelon]], a [[Voltfruit]], [[Fresh Milk]], and either a [[Hearty Radish]] or [[Big Hearty Radish]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Soups made with a regular Hearty Radish heal eight [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]] and sell for 50 [[Rupee]]s. Soups made with Big Hearty Radishes heal eleven Hearts and sell for 70 Rupees. Unlike many other [[Food]]s, there are no variations of Creamy Heart Soup that grant additional affects. These soups are known to be sweet, and sharing them is believed to bring two people closer together. During her [[Cooking Class]] in [[Gerudo Town]], [[Ashai]] will mention that she was planning on making Creamy Heart Soup.{{Cite|Hmm... I was planning on {{Color BotW|Red|creamy heart soup}} for the lesson today, but I'm being a bit forgetful, it seems.|Ashai|BotW}} However, when reciting the recipe to Link, she will name every ingredient but the Hearty Radishes, claiming she cannot remember them.{{Cite|I know that I need some {{Color BotW|Blue|fresh milk}}, one {{Color BotW|Blue|voltfruit}}, one {{Color BotW|Blue|hydromelon}}, and two heart-shaped vegetables...|Ashai|BotW}}{{Cite|I just can't recall what the heart-shaped vegetable was...|Ashai|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Creamy Heart Soup is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Needs a Splash of...]]". It is made using four [[Hydromelon]]s, four [[Voltfruit]]s, four [[Hearty Radish]]es, and four [[Fresh Milk]]s, but the Recipe can be lowered to three of through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]] will recover health every 10 seconds. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Creamy Heart Soup Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Creamy Heart Soup icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Creamy Meat Soup * Creamy Seafood Soup * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Soups |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
